facts.fact: Nation Online reports Malawi's National Registration Bureau is mandated to register births, national IDs and deaths, so one body holds both registers.

MWI.note: Nothing says civil registration is digital.

facts.fact: Nation Online says the Malawi Electoral Commission will for the first time require the national ID to register voters, from the 21 October 2024 registration.

MWI.note: Cards printed are stated, no share of population.
No number given at birth stated.
Printing capacity only; no day-to-day operation or ownership stated.

facts.fact: Nation Online says voter registration in Malawi requires a valid national ID under section 4(12) of the Presidential, Parliamentary and Local Government Act.
Nation Online quotes the NRB spokesperson saying NRB printed 1.8 million national IDs under distribution and had completed printing a further 1.5 million.

MWI.note: Nothing says civil events are registered digitally.
